name: SuGaR Mesh Extraction
aliases: SuGaR / Gaussian Frosting — Mesh extraction from optimized Gaussians
definition: A method to extract a surface mesh from Gaussian Splatting by regularizing Gaussians to align with the true scene surface. It uses Poisson reconstruction on points sampled from the visible level set of the Gaussian splatting density function.
summary: SuGaR Mesh Extraction converts 3D Gaussian Splatting into editable triangular meshes by enforcing surface alignment constraints during optimization, enabling traditional mesh-editing tools.
